chapter: The levee club and the St. Louis scene
title: Dago Hill, Zutty and Marge in Creath's band
summary: Asked about Dago Hill, Thomas places Zutty Singleton and Marge Creath in Charlie Creath's band, years older than him, and mentions the Grand Central Hotel.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Well, where was Dago Hill that Zooty and Marge were talking about?

That's in St. Louis. Now you must remember, Zooty and Marge would be around 5 or 10 years older at least. ... See, Zooty and Marge played together in Charlie Creath's band and Charlie Creath was a professional trumpet player where I'm trying to get so it makes a difference. I don't know what the age... I thought they were wonderful. I still think they're wonderful. Zoot and Marge and Charlie, they're something else. Dago Hill is down the road a piece. We used to go over to St. Louis. I can say this out. I was adventurous, you know, because I wanted to do what the other guys were doing. There's a place called Grand Central. It's a hotel. I guess it might still be there. The Grand Central Hotel.
